reserveReview.reviewer: Pharos reserve research agent (2026-08-20 current-source refresh)
reserveReview.rationale: Current-source re-check on 2026-08-20: HeLa's live HLUSD documentation still states that HLUSD is fully backed by custodial USDC reserves managed by a licensed financial institution in Australia and that 1 HLUSD equals 1 USDC. The complete disclosed direct reserve dependency is therefore USDC (100%). No third-party reserve attestation, auditor report, proof-of-reserves dashboard, or dated reserve-to-liability reconciliation is published on the current HeLa or StableHodl documentation; the whitepaper describes regular-audit design intent without a dated report or named custodian.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current HeLa issuer documentation for the HLUSD reserve and redemption model
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No direct reserve asset remains unidentified in the issuer's current full-backing disclosure. Assurance cadence, third-party attestations, and named custodian continuity remain undisclosed.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: 2026-07-30: HeLa still identifies only a licensed Australian financial institution / regulated custodians without naming the provider, license type, reserve account segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation terms, anti-rehypothecation controls, or failure/replacement/successor-custody mechanics. Whitepaper §6.2 states a committee of reputable companies will manage fiat-asset custody and regular auditing, but publishes no active roster or legal vehicle.
